status: partial historical monitoring profile; MSFN/PFP processor cadence sourced, inter-source freshness unresolved
applicability: Apollo 11 / Mission G LM powered-descent Mission Control guidance monitoring; source-backed MSFN/PFP timing metadata is inspectable, but comparisons remain non-executable until inter-source observation freshness is source-bounded

comparisons.purpose: Detect an in-plane disagreement requiring isolation with an independent ground comparison
provenance: MSC Internal Note 70-FM-20, The Apollo 11 Adventure, Figure 4 MCC velocity residual monitoring
comparisons.evidence_note: Apollo 11 Figure 4 gives 10-fps radial and downrange limits in the powered-descent in-plane monitoring path. Exact observation age/cadence for an executable comparison remains unfrozen.

comparisons.purpose: Use an independent ground-derived comparison to help isolate whether PGNS or AGS is the discrepant source
provenance: MSC Internal Note 70-FM-20, The Apollo 11 Adventure, Figure 4 MCC velocity residual monitoring
comparisons.evidence_note: The Apollo 11 monitoring flow uses powered-flight-processor/PGNS in-plane residuals after an AGS/PGNS discrepancy. The 10-fps isolation limits are source-bounded; freshness is not.

comparisons.purpose: PGNS failure-limit comparison after a possible PGNS discrepancy has been isolated
provenance: MSC Internal Note 70-FM-20, The Apollo 11 Adventure, Figure 4 MCC velocity residual monitoring
comparisons.evidence_note: Apollo 11 Figure 4 gives 35-fps radial and 30-fps downrange limits. Mission Rule 3-50 makes PGNS navigation errors violating PGNS failure limits an abort basis before landing-radar incorporation. This profile does not itself make the abort decision.

comparisons.purpose: Detect crossrange guidance disagreement requiring further isolation
provenance: MSC Internal Note 70-FM-20, The Apollo 11 Adventure, Figure 4 MCC velocity residual monitoring
comparisons.evidence_note: Apollo 11 Figure 4 shows a 20-fps AGS/PGNS crossrange monitoring limit. Other crossrange/misalignment branches remain intentionally unencoded until their labels and applicability are independently verified.

timing_evidence.evidence_note: Mission G requirements expect high-speed S-band tracking at 10 measurements/s and PFP measurement processing at 0.2- or 0.4-second intervals, with output time-tagging. These processor/input cadences are not a maximum permissible PGNCS/AGS/MSFN observation-time separation and do not close the historical freshness gate.
